text:
Connor O'Brien: heads up — trying to slot SCM rollout into next release train. Can we target enabling cost-model-service + Console integration behind flag in Train 2025.03.1 (deploy window Thu)? Need owners to confirm go/no-go checklist and gating.

Connor O'Brien: Proposed rollout sequence:
1) ship service + API gateway route (feature flag OFF)
2) ship Console client + caching/fallback (flag OFF)
3) canary enable by tenant allowlist (internal + 1–2 friendly)
4) widen to 10% hosted tenants, then dedicated, then private (where enabled)

Talia Benson: +1. For program tracking, can we align on explicit go/no-go criteria? Last time we had staging timeouts that impacted Console pages.

Benji Okafor: I can own the flagging/allowlist + config toggles. Need to know what metric thresholds we’re using for auto-pause.

Sean Gallagher: For SRE, I’m good w/ Thu window if:
- dashboards/alerts are in place BEFORE first canary
- Console has a hard timeout + graceful fallback (no page regressions)
- rollback plan is written + tested (disable flags + route if needed)

Marissa Cole: Console side: we have fallback to existing “no breakdown available” state + copy. But I want to ensure we don’t show $0 or misleading numbers when SCM errors.

Chloe Martin: Console backend currently: 250ms timeout + 1 retry (hedged) and cache the last known good breakdown per (tenant, model, route) for 15m. If SCM unavailable, we serve cached or omit breakdown. No $0 default.

Connor O'Brien: Great. Let’s formalize checklist here (and I’ll paste into release checklist doc).

Connor O'Brien: Go/No-Go checklist draft (SCM Train 2025.03.1)

Pre-merge / pre-cut:
- [ ] Version negotiation tests passing in CI (ENG-23203 / PR-18533)
- [ ] Explain endpoint payload size within limits (no >256KB responses) (PR-18677)
- [ ] Audit logging events implemented + reviewed (PR-18579)
- [ ] Telemetry dims added w/ cardinality caps (PR-18519)
- [ ] Runtime signals deployed to >=90% of fleet in canary regions (PR-18488, PR-18501)

Pre-canary enable:
- [ ] Cost Model API SLO dashboard live (p95/p99 + error rate) + alerts wired (PR-18602)
- [ ] Canary drift detector enabled (SCM estimate vs metered attribution) (perf-canary PR-421)
- [ ] Console fallback validated in staging (timeout / 5xx / invalid version)
- [ ] Optimize “what-if” integration remains OFF (separate flag) (PR-18563)

Canary gate (internal + allowlist tenants for 2–4h):
- [ ] availability >= 99.9% over window OR no sustained 5xx > 0.5% for 15m
- [ ] p95 latency <= 120ms, p99 <= 250ms (service-side)
- [ ] Console page error rate not increased (baseline +0.2% max)
- [ ] drift: median delta within ±5% for fixed prompt set; no single scenario >15% without known assumption tag
- [ ] validation rejects <0.1% requests (we had missing region issues)

Go/No-Go decision:
- GO if all gates green for 2h; NO-GO if any red alert or Console regression. Rollback is disable flags + remove gateway route if needed.

Priya Natarajan: Looks good. One nuance: runtime signals rollout varies by region. For missing signals we rely on assumptions/confidence. Can we gate canary on “unknown inputs rate” too?

Jordan Lee: +1. We should track “assumption_usage_rate” and “confidence=low” share. If that spikes, Console UX gets noisy.

Rafael Mendes: I can wire “unknown_inputs_rate” into the canary dashboard. Suggest thresholds:
- unknown_inputs_rate < 2% for canary tenants
- confidence=low < 5% of responses
If either exceeded for 15m -> auto-pause expansion.

Amara Diallo: API gateway route is behind `scm_api_enabled` in edge config. Rollback is instant. But removing the route entirely needs a second config push; still <10m.

Aditya Rao: Optimize is fine staying off in this train. For later, we’ll need a bulk/”multi-scenario” strategy, but not blocking initial.

Marissa Cole: For Console, can we add explicit check that “estimated” label is present when confidence != high? We aligned on messaging.

Chloe Martin: Already in the response mapping: we display “Estimated cost” always for SCM output (until billing approved). If confidence low, we add tooltip + show assumptions. If response missing confidence, we hide breakdown.

Sean Gallagher: Re: thresholds, p95 120ms seems tight but ok if cached. What’s current perf on load test?

Connor O'Brien: From release notes in PR-18641: p95 ~85ms, p99 ~190ms at 500 rps w/ internal cache warm. Cold cache p99 ~240ms. So 120/250 should be feasible.

DeployBot: staging deploy started for cost-model-service (build redwood@1c7f3a2). Tracking: #deployments-staging

Benji Okafor: For expansion: I’ll set flags as:
- `scm_service_enabled` (service accepting traffic)
- `scm_console_client_enabled` (Console reads SCM)
- `scm_tenant_allowlist` (CSV)
- `scm_region_allowlist` (default canary regions)
We can pause by clearing allowlist.

Talia Benson: Please add “Security sign-off completed” to checklist. Audit events include tenant + actor; security asked for redaction guidance.

Connor O'Brien: Good call. Adding:
- [ ] Security review sign-off for audit logging + access controls (ENG-23231)

Rafael Mendes: Also, incident comms: if Console degrades due to SCM, do we page release or SRE? I’d prefer SRE primary, release FYI.

Sean Gallagher: SRE primary. If alert `console_breakdown_degraded` fires, page SRE oncall; if `scm_error_budget_burn` fires, page SCM oncall (platform). Release gets ping in #eng-releases for awareness.

Priya Natarajan: Works.

Connor O'Brien: Cool. I’ll lock Train 2025.03.1 slot for SCM (flags OFF by default). Owners: Benji for flags, Chloe/Marissa for Console validation, Rafael/Sean for dashboards + canary gates. We’ll do go/no-go check 1h before enabling allowlist.

Connor O'Brien: If anyone objects to Thu window, speak now. Otherwise I’ll send calendar + paste checklist into `cost-model-api-release-checklist` doc.

Aditya Rao: No objections.

Marissa Cole: 👍

Benji Okafor: 👍

Sean Gallagher: 👍

Rafael Mendes: 👍
